verses.en: I am the man that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.
verses.sm: Atua O aʻu le tagata ua iloa le puapuaga i le sasa o lona toasa.

verses.en: He hath led me, and brought me into darkness, but not into light.
verses.sm: Ua ia ta‘ita‘i ma au mai ia te au i le pouliuli, a e le o le malamalama.

verses.en: Surely against me is he turned; he turneth his hand against me all the day.
verses.sm: E moni, ua ia toe liliu mai lona aao e aoai ia te au i le aso atoa.

verses.en: My flesh and my skin hath he made old; he hath broken my bones.
verses.sm: O ia ua agosi ai oʻu aano ma oʻu pa'u; ua gauia e ia oʻu ivi.

verses.en: He hath builded against me, and compassed me with gall and travail.
verses.sm: § Ua ia ati ae “olo e tau ma aʻu, ua ia siomia aʻu i le mea oona ma le tiga.

verses.en: He hath set me in dark places, as they that be dead of old.
verses.sm: Ua ia faanofoina aʻu i mea pogisa, e pei o E ua oti anamua.

verses.en: He hath hedged me about, that I cannot get out: he hath made my chain heavy.
verses.sm: Ua ia puipuia aʻu i itu uma, ou te le mafai ona alu atu ai; ua faamamafaina e ia oʻu noanoaga “apa memea.

verses.en: Also when I cry and shout, he shutteth out my prayer.
verses.sm: A ou alaga atu foi ma uio, ua 1a pupuni mai i laʻu tatalo.

verses.en: He hath inclosed my ways with hewn stone, he hath made my paths crooked.
verses.sm: Ua ia punitia ofu ala i maa talai, ua ia faapiopioina o°u magaala.

verses.en: He was unto me as a bear lying in wait, and as a lion in secret places.
verses.sm: O le urosa lamalama o ia ia te au, o le leona foi i mea lilo.

verses.en: He hath turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces: he hath made me desolate.
verses.sm: Ua ia faaliliu ese oʻu ala, ua ia saeia au; ua ia faanofotoatasiina o aʻu.

verses.en: He hath bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.
verses.sm: Ua lolo‘u e ia lana aufana, ua ia faatuina aʻu e pei o se manulauti e fana i ai.

verses.en: He hath caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins.
verses.sm: Ua lavea ia te ia oʻu fatuga‘o i ana u fanafana.

verses.en: I was a derision to all my people; and their song all the day.
verses.sm: Ua fai au ma tauemuga i loʻu nuu uma, o la latou pese i le aso atoa.

verses.en: He hath filled me with bitterness, he hath made me drunken with wormwood.
verses.sm: Ua ia fagaina aʻu ia ma‘ona i mea oona, ua ia faainu ia te au ia onā i le laena.

verses.en: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones, he hath covered me with ashes.
verses.sm: Ua ia faamomomo ou nifo i iliili, ua ia ufitia aʻu i le lefulefu.

verses.en: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace: I forgat prosperity.
verses.sm: Ua e teena aʻu ia ma tetea ma le filemu; ou galo ia te au le manuia.

verses.en: And I said, My strength and my hope is perished from the LORD:
verses.sm: Ona ou faapea ifo lea, Ua faaumatia loʻu faatuatuaga ma loʻu faamoemoega mai le ALII.

verses.en: Remembering mine affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.
verses.sm: la e manatu i loʻu puapuaga ma loʻu agaleagaina, o le laena ma le rosa.

verses.en: My soul hath them still in remembrance, and is humbled in me.
verses.sm: la e manatua lava, ua faanoʻunoʻu loʻu loto i totonu ia te au.

verses.en: This I recall to my mind, therefore have I hope.
verses.sm: O le mea lenei ua toe manatu i ai loʻu. loto, o le mea lea e faamoemoe ai aʻu.

verses.en: It is of the LORD'S mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.
verses.sm: O le alofa o le ALI ua le faaumatia ai i tatou, ona ua le mavae o lona alofa mutimutivale;

verses.en: They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
verses.sm: e fou mai ia i taeao uma; e tele lou faamaoni.

verses.en: The LORD is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.
verses.sm: Ua faapea ifo loʻu loto, O loʻu tofi o le ALII lea, o le mea lea ou te faamoemoe ai ia te ia.

verses.en: The LORD is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.
verses.sm: O loo agalelei le ALII i e faatalitali ia te ia, o le tagata e saili ia te ia.

verses.en: It is good that a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.
verses.sm: E lelei ona faaməemoe ma le faalologo i le olataga mai le ALII.

verses.en: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.
verses.sm: E lelei i le tagata ina ia tauave e ia le amo ina o taulealea.

verses.en: He sitteth alone and keepeth silence, because he hath borne it upon him.
verses.sm: E nofo toatasi o ia ma faalologo, ina ua faaeetia i luga ia te ia.

verses.en: He putteth his mouth in the dust; if so be there may be hope.
verses.sm: E tuu e ia łona gutu i le efuefu, pe na te maua se faamoemoe.

verses.en: He giveth his cheek to him that smiteth him: he is filled full with reproach.
verses.sm: E tuu atu e ia o lona alafau i lē tuʻi mai, e faatumuina o ia i le faalumaina.

verses.en: For the Lord will not cast off for ever:
verses.sm: Auā e le tuulafoaiina e faavavau e le Alii;

verses.en: But though he cause grief, yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his mercies.
verses.sm: auā e ui lava ina faatiga mai o ia, e toe alofa mutimuti vale mai O ia e tusa ma le tele o lona alofa.

verses.en: For he doth not afflict willingly nor grieve the children of men.
verses.sm: Auā e le fiafia o ia ona faapuapuagaina pe faatigaina tagata.

verses.en: To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the earth,
verses.sm: O le soli i lalo o ona vae o e noatia uma o le nuu,

verses.en: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the most High,
verses.sm: o le faapiopioina o le faamasinoga ol e tagata i luma o le Silisili ese,

verses.en: To subvert a man in his cause, the Lord approveth not.
verses.sm: o le faaseseina o le tagata i lana finauga; o mea ia e le fia silasila i ai le Alii.

verses.en: Who is he that saith, and it cometh to pass, when the Lord commandeth it not?
verses.sm: Po o ai o ia e fai atu, ona 00 ai lea, a e lei fetalai mai ai le Alii?

verses.en: Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil and good?
verses.sm: E le túlei ifo ea i le fofoga o le Silisili ese o mea leaga atoa ma le lelei?

verses.en: Wherefore doth a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?
verses.sm: Pe se a le mea ua muimui ai le tagata ola, o le tagata ona o lana sala?

verses.en: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD.
verses.sm: Seʻi tatou suesue i o tatou ala ma filifili, ma ia tatou toe foi atu i le ALII.

verses.en: Let us lift up our heart with our hands unto God in the heavens.
verses.sm: Se'i tatou sii atu O tatou loto faatasi ma o tatou lima i le Atua o i le lagi.

verses.en: We have transgressed and have rebelled: thou hast not pardoned.
verses.sm: Ua solitulafono i matou, ma ua fouvale i matou; ua e le faamagalo mai.

verses.en: Thou hast covered with anger, and persecuted us: thou hast slain, thou hast not pitied.
verses.sm: Ua e ufitia i matou i le toasa, ma e tuliloa ia i matou; ua e fasiotia, ua le alofa mai.

verses.en: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud, that our prayer should not pass through.
verses.sm: Ua e ufitia oe i le ao, ina ia le sao atu ai le tatalo.

verses.en: Thou hast made us as the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people.
verses.sm: Ua e faia i matou ma otaota, ta mea e inosia i luma o nuu.

verses.en: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.
verses.sm: O i latou uma o e ita mai ia te i matou ua faamamaga o latou gutu ia te i matou.

verses.en: Fear and a snare is come upon us, desolation and destruction.
verses.sm: Ua ia te i matou le fefe ma le lua, o le faatafunaina ma le lepetia o mea.

verses.en: Mine eye runneth down with rivers of water for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
verses.sm: Ua tafe ifo vaitafe i oʻu mata ona ua tu'imomomo le tama fafine a loʻu nuu.

verses.en: Mine eye trickleth down, and ceaseth not, without any intermission,
verses.sm: Ua tafe ifo loimata i oʻu mata, ua le mapu, ua le aunoa lava,

verses.en: Till the LORD look down, and behold from heaven.
verses.sm: seia silasila ifo le ALII, ma ia silafia mai mai le lagi;

verses.en: Mine eye affecteth mine heart because of all the daughters of my city.
verses.sm: o oʻu mata e tiga ai loʻu loto, ona o tama fafine uma a laʻu aai.

verses.en: Mine enemies chased me sore, like a bird, without cause.
verses.sm: O e ita fua mai ia te au, ua latou matuā tuli mai ia te au, e pei se manu lele.

verses.en: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and cast a stone upon me.
verses.sm: Ua latou faaumatia loʻu ola i le lua; ua lafo mai le maa i luga ia te au.

verses.en: Waters flowed over mine head; then I said, I am cut off.
verses.sm: Na lofia loʻu ulu i le vai, na ou faapea ifo, Ua ou fano.

verses.en: I called upon thy name, O LORD, out of the low dungeon.
verses.sm: Le ALII e, na ou valaau atu i lou suafa ai le lua e maulalo.

verses.en: Thou hast heard my voice: hide not thine ear at my breathing, at my cry.
verses.sm: Na e faafofogaina loʻu leo; aua neʻi “alo ou fofoga i loʻu mapuitiga ma laʻu alaga.

verses.en: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee: thou saidst, Fear not.
verses.sm: Na e faalatalata mai ia te au i le aso na ou valaau atu ai ia te oe; na e fetalai mai, Aua le fefe.

verses.en: O Lord, thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; thou hast redeemed my life.
verses.sm: Le Alii e, ua e faia laʻu finauga; ua e togiolaina aʻu.

verses.en: O LORD, thou hast seen my wrong: judge thou my cause.
verses.sm: Le ALII e, ua e silafia le agaleagaina o aʻu; ia e faia loʻu faamasinoga.

verses.en: Thou hast seen all their vengeance and all their imaginations against me.
verses.sm: Ua e silafia uma lava lo latou fia taui mai, ma o latou mafaufauga uma ia te au.

verses.en: Thou hast heard their reproach, O LORD, and all their imaginations against me;
verses.sm: Le ALII e, ua e faafofogaina lo latou faaluma mai, ma o latou mafaufauga uma ia te au;

verses.en: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.
verses.sm: o upu a e laga mai ia te au, ma le mea ua latou mafaufau i ai ia te au i le aso atoa.

verses.en: Behold their sitting down, and their rising up; I am their musick.
verses.sm: A latou nonofo i lalo pe tutū i luga, ia e silasila, ua fai la latou pese ia te au.

verses.en: Render unto them a recompence, O LORD, according to the work of their hands.
verses.sm: Le ALII e, ia e taui atu ia te i latou, e tusa ma mea ua faia e o latou lima.

verses.en: Give them sorrow of heart, thy curse unto them.
verses.sm: Ia e tuuina atu ia te i latou o le loto faalogogata, ia e faafano ia te i latou.

verses.en: Persecute and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the LORD.
verses.sm: Ia e tuliloa ia te i latou i lou toasa, ia e faaumatia i latou ai lalo o le lagi o le
